changelog:
# Simply More 1.3.0 ALPHA
Various Uniques that are marked for rework have had their functionality removed - and currently do nothing. I have tried to remove as many crashes as possible, but expect them with these older Uniques.

1.20.1 port may come after I am finished with 1.21.1

THIS UPDATE WILL BREAK CONFIG FILES, AND MANY WILL BE RESET TO DEFAULT VALUES.

## Additions
- Weapon types now have implicit abilities, just as Simply Swords weapon types after v1.70.
- Began implementation of Iron's Spells and Spellbooks compatibility. This will only exist for reworked uniques.
- Added the Reforming Remnant, allowing you to pick between multiple uniques that occupy the same transformation block for contained remnants.

## General Changes
- Various effects that triggered on hit can now only trigger once per swing, and not once per entity hit.
- Various effects that were once status effects are now handled separately, and cannot be cleared by milk.

- Bleed status renamed to Wounded, and no longer causes damage over time.
- Unique effects no longer hit mounted mobs or pets.

- Lance bonus damage is now an implicit ability, instead of being handled as a status effect.
- Mjolnir is no longer counted as a chakram for the purpose of Mimi-cry.

- Mythic Metals compat items that should not burn in lava no longer do so.

## Removals
- Removed Carver items, as v1.70 makes them obsolete. You will be refunded an empowered remnant.

## Changes to Uniques

### Molten Flare
- Renamed "Magmaseep".
- New passive and active ability.
- Increased base damage.

### Exedrill
- Renamed "Moundshifter".
- New active ability, and heavily tweaked the passive ability.

### Grandfrost
- Updated FX on the passive ability.
- New active ability.
- Increased base damage.

### Lustrous Moxie
- Reworked passive and active ability.
- NOTE: this weapon has a screen flash feature. This can be turned into a darker flash in Client Configs.

### Soul Foreseer
- Renamed "Soulfracture".
- Reworked passive and active ability.

### Black Pearl
- Updated FX on passive and active ability.
- Shoots a custom cannonball projectile with consistent damage, instead of relying on fireball logic.

### The Blood Harvester
- Heavily updated FX on active ability.
- New texture.

### Ruyi Jingu Bang
- Updated FX on the active ability.
- Added passive ability.
- Tweaked active ability.

### Blade of the Grotesque
- Active ability now grants full immunity to damage.
- Active ability now preserves momentum, instead of stopping you in the air.
- Updated FX on the passive and active ability.
- Tweaked sprite.

### Matterbane
- Tweaked the texture.
- Now dyes with higher saturation (this was removed last update), to make it look better - though without affecting hue.

### Tidebreaker
- Slightly reshaded texture.

### Jester Penetrate
- Can now be repaired with any wool block, included modded ones.

# Fixes
- Fixed a crash when all available Mimi-cry forms were on cooldown.
- Fixed a crash that occurs with Viper's Call's passive effect in heavily modded environments.
- Fixed the Weapon Attributes config not prompting for a game restart on change.
- Fixed effect blacklist configs prompting for a game restart erroneously.
- Fixed Simply More two-handed weapons not scaling gem powers correctly.
- Fixed "Venom" being translated to "Toxic"
- Fixed Black Pearl's passive ability stealing instant effects, and thus getting no benefit.

# Misc Changes
- Removed startup log spam.
- Removed items are now instantly converted to its replacement, instead of prompting a right click first.
- Most abilities now disappear if the weapon is unselected, the owner dies, or the owner leaves.

name: Simply More 1.2.0+1.21.1
changelog:
## Welcome SimplyMore to 1.21.1!

SimplyMore has migrated over to NeoForge for its Forge releases, and has officially been ported to 1.21.1. Versions below this will not receive new upgrades.



### Compat Changes

* No longer has integration with Patchouli.
* Disabled Gobber2 Compatibility.
* Configs are now handled via FzzyConfig instead of ClothConfig.
* Added config integration with Mod Menu.
* Added Open Parties and Claims compatibility.



### Misc Changes

* Advancements are now translatable.
* Dropped the en\_gb translations to help with maintenance.



### Gameplay Changes

* Glimmerstep no longer hits your mount when using its explosion.
* Glimmerstep Starlight speed boost now affects your mount.
* Exedrill tremors, explosion and rocks no longer hits your mount.
* SimplyMore no longer has a separate loot table, and instead injects into the SimplySwords loot table. This means it is no longer possible to get a unique from SimplySwords and SimplyMore at the same time.



### Fixes

* Matterbane's Negative Energy particle now has consistent hitboxes.
* The Blood Harvester no longer has inconsistent damage modifiers on its swing cycle.
